title: Require the skill answer on capture stubs for skill-owning areas
action: Per D4 item 5: a capture stub for an area that owns a skill must answer whether the skill changed. In capture.rs:263 `run_add` add `--skill-answer "<changed: <path>|not: <why>>"`: when `--area` names an area whose `owns.skills` (knowledge::ownership::load_ownership) is non-empty, a missing or blank --skill-answer refuses by name, listing the area's owned skills and the two accepted spellings; when the area owns no skill, or no --area is given, the flag is optional. Store the answer on the stub as `skill_answer`. Unit tests beside the existing capture tests (find them: rg -n 'fn .*capture' packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/verbs/*.rs — create capture_tests.rs only if none exist, registering it in verbs/mod.rs): skill-owning area without the flag refuses naming the skills; with `changed: skills/x/SKILL.md` succeeds; area without owned skills needs no flag. Update `capture add` help in src/generated/registry_payload.json and the catalog count. Sync the home spec docs/knowledge/areas/workflow-state/capture-queue-and-the-blocker-threshold.md (the stub field + the rule) and skills/bee-capturing/SKILL.md ('Capture the moment it settles': one line — a stub for a skill-owning area carries the skill answer; pointer to the spec); then run the regen chain because skills/ is a manifest root.
verify: PATH="${CARGO_HOME:-$HOME/.cargo}/bin:$PATH" cargo test --release --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml -p bee capture && PATH="${CARGO_HOME:-$HOME/.cargo}/bin:$PATH" cargo test --release --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml -p bee --test registry_contracts && .bee/bin/bee dev release-manifest --check

truths: capture add --area <skill-owning area> without --skill-answer is refused naming the area's owned skills
capture add with --skill-answer stores skill_answer on the stub; an area owning no skill needs no flag
